mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM river r LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON r.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON r.manager_id = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON r.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_cleaning_type ct ON r.cleaning_type_id = ct.cleaning_type_id AND ct.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_monitor_type mt ON r.monitor_type_id = mt.monitor_type_id AND mt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_monitor_status mst ON r.monitor_status_id = mst.monitor_status_id AND mst.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_problem_type pt ON r.problem_type_id = pt.sys_problem_type_id AND pt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_handle_status hs ON r.handle_status_id = hs.sys_handle_status_id AND hs.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_task_type tt ON r.task_type_id = tt.sys_task_type_id AND tt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON r.dept_id = d.sys_dept_id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON r.monitor_by = u2.user_id AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON r.report_by = u3.user_id AND u3.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u4 ON r.handle_by = u4.user_id AND u4.deleted = 0
